publication.title: QBEES: query-by-example entity search in semantic knowledge graphs based on maximal aspects, diversity-awareness and relaxation

adjudication.basis: The minimum test is interactive workflow OR guidance/recommendation. QBEES targets ambiguity in user-provided YAGO entity examples, ranks semantic aspects/candidates and relaxes constraints. This satisfies a KG-grounded recommendation method even though the interactive extension is separate/future work.

backend.source_model_description: Java8 method using YAGO2 core2.3.0 in PostgreSQL9.5; ontology hierarchy loaded in memory, MRU cache of aspect entity sets; graph popularity via Apache Giraph or Wikipedia page-view counts

descriptions.interaction: Input one or more example entities and return a ranked entity list; adding examples is motivated as implicit refinement, but an implemented interactive interface/feedback loop is not described in this report
descriptions.guidance: Candidate ranking models ambiguous intent as distinct maximal aspects; type filtering, popularity priors and aspect relaxation diversify/extend results; no verified on-screen guidance workflow in this report

report_level_evaluation.design: Offline benchmark retrieval evaluation and model ablation; separate single-thread runtime experiment
report_level_evaluation.tasks: Entity-list completion from1–5 relevant example entities; INEX2007 used for model analysis, INEX2008,SemSearch2011,QALD3,QALD4 for comparisons
report_level_evaluation.comparators: Random walk with restart, Bron et al. hybrid textual/structural entity-search method, random ranking and QBEES variants
report_level_evaluation.measures: MAP,nDCG,precision,recall,MRR at10/100,ranking length; runtime components and total variant runtime over200 queries repeated3times
report_level_evaluation.results: Stronger variants outperform competing retrieval models for at least2 examples on INEX2008/SemSearch in most settings, with documented exceptions;QALD gains are larger because ground-truth SPARQL star patterns align with aspect structure. Share-threshold+one-step relaxation improves quality/runtime tradeoff. Cold-cache mean components: entity-set retrieval2.22s,candidate construction.12s,maximal aspect computation.06s,ranking/selection.32s. No user-study outcomes are reported.; limits: Only YAGO2 tested; queries/relevance sets change with example count and must not be compared across sizes as matched queries. Entity mapping removes unmappable relevant answers. Benchmarks structurally favor the aspect model, especially QALD. Baseline implementations are not optimized and random-walk runtime was not measured in the same setup; runtime excludes one-time initialization. Iterative navigation is future/separate work.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Not reported: participants. Only YAGO2 tested; queries/relevance sets change with example count and must not be compared across sizes as matched queries.
